about: A session agrees on shape fingerprints before its first record. `client` says how the client's record shape relates to the writer's: `same` (equal fingerprints) or `incompatible` (a shape the writer's does not read). A refusal names the shape that disagrees.

vectors.name: two ends holding the same record shape open a session
a client whose record shape is incompatible is refused at open, by name
